name: get_me
description: Get the signed-in Figma user: id, email, handle, and avatar image URL. Use to identify whose Figma account is connected.

name: get_file
description: Get a compact summary of a Figma design file by its file key: name, last modified time, version, editor type, role, thumbnail URL, and the list of top-level pages (id, name, type, child count). Use to understand the structure of a Figma design file without fetching the full node tree.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (the segment after /file/ or /design/ in a Figma URL).

depth.description: How many levels of the document tree to traverse (default 2). Lower values return less data.

name: list_comments
description: List comments on a Figma design file. Returns each comment's id, message, author handle, created time, and resolved time. Use to review feedback and discussion on a design.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (the segment after /file/ or /design/ in a Figma URL).

name: get_file_nodes
description: Get specific nodes from a Figma design file by their node ids. Returns a compact map of node id to { name, type }. Use to inspect particular frames, components, or layers within a design file.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (the segment after /file/ or /design/ in a Figma URL).

node_ids.description: Comma-separated list of node ids to retrieve (e.g. "1:2,1:3").

name: get_file_images
description: Render images of specific nodes in a Figma design file. Returns a map of node id to a rendered image URL. Use to get visual previews (PNG, SVG, or JPG) of frames, components, or layers from a design.

file_key.description: The Figma file key (the segment after /file/ or /design/ in a Figma URL).

node_ids.description: Comma-separated list of node ids to render (e.g. "1:2,1:3").
